When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

Gyllenhaal stars alongside Phoebe Dynevor, Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty and Jay O. Sanders.

Which helped Robert Pattinson secure the James Bond Role. 

He follows Daniel Craig James Bond after No Time To Die and all previous James Bond Actors like Pierce Brosnan, Timothy Dalton, Roger Moore, George Lazenby and original James Bond Sean Connery. They have not announced the story details of the new James Bond 2028 Movie, but he is holding a modern weapon in the announcement, so the movie will not be a period piece, it will take place in present day. 

They have not announced who the new James Bond Villain is either. Which will be one of the next things they do. The reason why they announced Robert Pattinson so early is because they begin filming soon. The movie will release right after The Batman 2. James Gunn announced he was out at DC Studios. Jeremy Latcham is replacing him. And he will cast a totally new actor for his Batman that will appear in canon DCU Batman movies, Justice League Crossovers and other films.

The DC Movies are in chaos right now, Superman 2 Man of Tomorrow is next, we will get a trailer for that soon. And we'll learn more about how Jeremy Latcham is going to change James Gunn's original 10 Year DC Movie Plan. 

David Corenswet will continue as Superman, and other James Gunn DC Characters will continue, but not all of them. I will do more videos about that when we learn which characters are also out and which ones are staying long term.
